Citizen · ref. NY0125-83E

Promaster Diver

Dive · 41–47mm · 200m–300m · automatic · 2021–2026

The Citizen Promaster Diver is a family of robust, purpose-built tool watches designed for professional and recreational diving. Defining features often include an ISO 6425 certification, high legibility with luminous markers, a unidirectional rotating bezel, and a crown typically positioned at 8 o'clock for ergonomics and protection.

The story

The Promaster line was officially launched in 1989, building on Citizen's history of water-resistant watches that began with the Parawater in 1959 and the iconic Aqualand in 1985, the first dive watch with a digital depth gauge. The early Promaster Divers, like the NY0040 "Fugu," quickly gained a reputation for reliability and were even adopted by the Italian Navy. Over the decades, the family has evolved from purely automatic movements to incorporating Citizen's light-powered Eco-Drive technology, which became a staple in the mid-1990s. While designs have been updated and materials like Super Titanium have been introduced, the core principle of providing accessible, durable, and highly functional dive watches has remained constant through generations of references.
